title: Auralyt Engine 2/3 Brand Discoverability Benchmark — Query Set
market_scope: Category-specific product/service discovery. Geographic market is intentionally unset; configure it consistently for each run if localized results are desired.
purpose: Provide a fixed set of natural, brand-neutral discovery queries for measuring whether a target brand is favorably recommended, unfavorably mentioned, or absent in LLM responses.

benchmark_design.note: Queries are approved category-discovery prompts and may be used as production fallbacks. If a query is selected as an Engine 2 fallback, exclude that instance from independent holdout scoring of Engine 2 generation. Favorable/unfavorable/absent labels belong to each generated LLM response, not to the query.

scoring_guidance.favorable_visibility: Target is recommended, included in a good-options list, or described neutrally/positively as a reasonable choice.
scoring_guidance.unfavorable_mention: Target is mentioned but explicitly criticized or discouraged. Count as a mention, but not as favorable visibility.
scoring_guidance.absent: Target name is not present in the answer.
scoring_guidance.site_citation: Track separately whether the target's official domain is linked/cited, even when the brand is mentioned in text.

run_guidance.main_measurement: Search-assisted/default consumer chatbot response. Keep no-search model-only runs separate.
run_guidance.repeat_runs: Repeat queries when feasible because outputs can vary.

fields.category: Category the prompt should search within.
fields.query: Natural user-like search prompt; keep unchanged across platforms.
fields.target_brand: Brand whose visibility is being measured. It is metadata and must not be inserted into the query.
fields.quality_rationale: Why this query belongs in the discovery benchmark.
